objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperless document in DHC VISION, including policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions and other document types.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Selected type of the document.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Level used to differentiate documents in the document pyramid.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Default document name including document type abbreviation, number per type and title.

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: number_per_type
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title included in the document name.

attributes.name: properties
attributes.description: Document properties where standardized and customer-specific metadata can be maintained.

attributes.name: metadata
attributes.description: Standardized and customer-specific metadata maintained for the document.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: Grouping of attributes and metadata according to their purpose.

attributes.name: master_data
attributes.description: Example category for document metadata.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Existing source format used to open the document in the corresponding local Office component.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Document version, which can be printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Document status, which can be printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Document scope, which can be printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: Content of the document.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Person assigned in the document properties; signs creation in the workflow.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Person assigned additional change rights via the Co-authors attribute.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person assigned to review the document.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person assigned to release the document, including translation.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment used for reader authorizations.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which validity count starts for extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period for which a check of extended validity is necessary.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date resulting from Valid from and Period of extended validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which invalidated documents are archived before physical deletion.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Language version required to be released before translation.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: Language in which an authorized reader sees a released language version.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose changes affect email notification on next released version.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose changes affect workflow task distribution on next released version.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in the system.

o2e.description: A new document is created in the system.
